epics.title: [Epic] Authentication
epics.body: Multi-persona auth (customer OTP, merchant password, rider OTP, admin). Source: codebase + ClickUp auth export (~90%). Remaining: admin 2FA strict, OTP rate limits, production strict flags, docs, E2E.

week_1.focus: Close MVP money + auth hard gaps

week_2.focus: Admin finance visibility + analytics + rider tracking

risks.risk: Admin finance UIs look complete but are mock-only — ops decisions on fake data
Rider cannot cash out earnings — blocks rider adoption
OTP strict mode off in prod defaults — auth bypass risk
Admin 2FA stub accepts any code when not strict
No CI — regressions can ship unnoticed
iOS not yet on TestFlight — Apple launch path unknown
Crypto checkout simulated — legal/financial risk if left enabled
Cart lacks server-side price validation — payment integrity risk

priorities_suggested: P0: Rider withdraw API+UI, OTP strict+rate limit, disable crypto sim, admin 2FA
P1: Admin transactions/payouts/analytics APIs+wiring, cart validation, CI
P2: iOS TestFlight + mobile QA + FCM verification
P3: Compliance audit log, privacy pages, monitoring
Phase 2: Disputes, support, settings, referrals, saved cards, crypto
